name: Supreme x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Camper Green'
story_html: Dropping as part of a collaborative footwear collection, the Supreme x Nike Dunk Low SB 'Camper Green' showcases a suede upper featuring a moss green base with a black signature Swoosh and Camper Green overlays at the forefoot and heel. In addition to a Nike SB tongue tag, branding elements include a Nike wordmark on the back tab and a '94' embroidered on the lateral heel — a nod to Supreme's founding year. Anchoring the sneaker is a dark green rubber midsole with 'Supreme' debossed on the lateral sidewall.
